newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eridania says would retain 51 pct of Koip.
newsitem.headline: Eridania says would retain 51 pct of Koip.

text.p: Franco-Italian food group Eridania Beghin-Say said on Tuesday it planned to soon open the capital of its Spanish olive oil unit Koipe to the public but intended to retain a 51 percent stake.
"We are working on it, things are well advanced...The operation will increase the liquidity of that major stock in Spain," chairman Stefano Meloni told the company's annual shareholders' meeting.
Meloni said that while the public might end up with around 40 percent of Koipe's capital, Eridania would "keep 51 percent in any case".
The public currently controls between six and seven percent of Kope's capital.
In April Meloni had said that Eridania would not make a capital gain from the sale and that its impact for the group would be neutral.
At end December Eridania bought a 9.66 percent in Koipe from Spain's Tabacalera, bringing its total stake in Koipe to 75.95 percent.
